semiconductor_relevance: Medium — JCU Taiwan Corporation provides electroplating solutions and chemicals that are integral to the manufacturing of PCBs and electronic components, which are crucial in semiconductor production.
summary: JCU Taiwan Corporation specializes in surface treatment technologies, focusing on electroplating solutions for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include chemicals and equipment designed to enhance surface properties of electronic components and PCBs, addressing both performance and environmental concerns.
capabilities: Automated transport systems for roll-to-roll processing

regional_presence.Taiwan: JCU Taiwan Corporation is based in Taiwan, focusing on providing surface treatment technologies and electroplating solutions for the local semiconductor and electronics industries.
